description_en: Queries the action plan, risk summary, approval status, assigned approvers, and actual processing records based on an approval request ID. You can obtain the approval request ID from the approval request list returned by ListApprovals
description_zh: 根据审批单 ID 查询操作计划、风险摘要、审批状态、指定审批人和实际处理记录。可从 ListApprovals 返回的审批单列表中取得审批单 ID
name: GetApprovalDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval request. The ID can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 审批单 ID，最长 128 个字符
parameters.name: approval_req_id

schema.description_en: The details of the approval request returned when the query is successful
schema.description_zh: 查询成功时返回的审批单详情

ActionPlan.description_en: The action plan submitted for approval, which lists the actions to be executed
ActionPlan.description_zh: 提交审批的操作计划，列出本次计划执行的动作
ActionPlan.example:
需审批动作（1 项）

调用 ECS API（1 项）
- 调用 DeleteInstance 1 次（版本：2014-05-26）

ApprovalReqId.description_en: The ID of the approval request. You can use this ID to query approval details or process the approval request
ApprovalReqId.description_zh: 审批单 ID。使用此 ID 查询审批详情或处理该审批单

ApprovedAt.description_en: The time when the approval request was actually processed. This field may have a value if the request is approved, rejected, or recalled. Approval requests created in a region use UTC time. The Z in the example indicates UTC
ApprovedAt.description_zh: 审批单实际被处理的时间，同意、拒绝或撤回时均可能有值。地域内创建的审批单使用 UTC 时间，示例中的 Z 表示 UTC

ApproverPrincipalId.description_en: The ID of the principal that actually performed the approve, reject, or recall operation
ApproverPrincipalId.description_zh: 实际执行同意、拒绝或撤回操作的主体标识

ApproverPrincipalName.description_en: The RAM username of the actual approver. This field is returned only if the username can be queried
ApproverPrincipalName.description_zh: 实际处理审批单的 RAM 用户名称。仅在能够查询到该用户名称时返回

ApproverPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the principal that actually processed the approval request. This type is used together with ApproverPrincipalId to identify the actual processor
ApproverPrincipalType.description_zh: 实际处理该审批单的主体类型。与 ApproverPrincipalId 一起标识实际处理人

AssignedApproverInfo.description_en: The information about the assigned approvers configured for the approval request
AssignedApproverInfo.description_zh: 该审批单配置的指定审批人信息

Approvers.description_en: The list of assigned approvers. Each item describes a principal assigned to process the approval request
Approvers.description_zh: 指定审批人列表，每项描述一位被指定处理此单的主体

ApproverPrincipalId.description_en: The principal ID of the assigned approver
ApproverPrincipalId.description_zh: 该指定审批人的主体标识

ApproverPrincipalName.description_en: The RAM username of the assigned approver. This field is returned only if the username can be queried
ApproverPrincipalName.description_zh: 该指定审批人的 RAM 用户名称。仅在能够查询到该用户名称时返回

ApproverPrincipalType.description_en: The principal type of the assigned approver
ApproverPrincipalType.description_zh: 该指定审批人的主体类型

ClientAgentName.description_en: The name of the client agent that initiated the operation
ClientAgentName.description_zh: 发起本次操作的客户端 Agent 名称

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the approval request was created. Approval requests created in a region use UTC time. The Z in the example indicates UTC
CreatedAt.description_zh: 审批单的创建时间。地域内创建的审批单使用 UTC 时间，示例中的 Z 表示 UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the action plan provided by the requester when submitting the approval request
Description.description_zh: 发起人提交审批时填写的操作计划说明
Description.example: 测试完成后清理临时 ECS 实例。

ExpiredAt.description_en: The expiration time of the approval request. Approval requests created in a region use UTC time. The Z in the example indicates UTC
ExpiredAt.description_zh: 审批单的到期时间。地域内创建的审批单使用 UTC 时间，示例中的 Z 表示 UTC

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud region to which the approval request belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 审批单所属的阿里云地域 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace the request and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的标识，用于关联请求和排查问题

RequesterPrincipalId.description_en: The ID of the principal that initiated the approval request. This ID is used together with RequesterPrincipalType to identify the requester
RequesterPrincipalId.description_zh: 审批单发起主体的标识，与 RequesterPrincipalType 一起标识发起人

RequesterPrincipalName.description_en: The RAM username of the requester. This field is returned only if the username can be queried
RequesterPrincipalName.description_zh: 发起审批的 RAM 用户名称。仅在能够查询到该用户名称时返回

RequesterPrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the principal that initiated the approval request. Valid values:
sub: RAM user.
customer: Alibaba Cloud account.
AssumedRoleUser: The session principal that assumes a RAM role
RequesterPrincipalType.description_zh:
审批单发起主体的类型。
sub 表示 RAM 用户
customer 表示阿里云主账号
AssumedRoleUser 表示扮演 RAM 角色的会话主体

RiskSummary.description_en: The risk summary of the action plan, which summarizes the actions in the plan and the actions that require approval
RiskSummary.description_zh: 本次操作计划的风险摘要，概括计划中的动作及需要审批的动作
RiskSummary.example: 本次共 1 项动作，全部需要审批：调用 ecs API 1 项。

ServerAgentName.description_en: The name of the server agent involved in the operation
ServerAgentName.description_zh: 本次操作涉及的服务端 Agent 名称

Status.description_en:
The current status of the approval request. Valid values:
PENDING: Pending.
APPROVED: Approved.
REJECTED: Rejected.
RECALLED: Recalled.
EXPIRED: Expired
Status.description_zh:
审批单当前状态。
PENDING 表示待处理。
APPROVED 表示已同意。
REJECTED 表示已拒绝。
RECALLED 表示已撤回
EXPIRED 表示已过期

Title.description_en: The title of the approval request, which summarizes the action plan submitted for approval
Title.description_zh: 审批单标题，概括本次提交审批的操作计划
Title.example: 清理测试环境的 ECS 实例
